headline: The title screen's first interactive state is the FE_initial press-start screen, class vtable 00CF6D90, size 0x18, screen id 5Ch. Its update 0067cfb0 pulses press_start_Text with |sin| of a 2.5 rad/s phase, and a press on input action 4Eh (or any button on the first attached device) drives the XenonSystemManager sign-in handshake at manager+28h. Phase 2 runs 0067cc60, which rebuilds the profile at game+650h and either reaches the main menu directly or through the storage callback 0067ca40. Every exit is BSP_TitleScreen_Skip 0068d8a0, that is state request 4. The screen id is not an interface id and no screen set is raised here.

follow_up_packets.contract: Recover the seven 0x48-byte prompt records at menu+60h, the ten-argument raise, the kind values, and how menu+188h/+218h gate a dismissal.
Recover the manager+3B0h state machine, the +28h handshake with the press-start screen, and the callback at manager+24h.
Recover the profile block at game+650h, the L"Session" save container at 0067d801, and the queue-with-callback contract 0067ca40 rides on.

tool_problems: python tools/bsp.py ghidra export fails with 'is not a function in this snapshot' for 0067cfb0 and 0067d860 even though ghidra proto reports a body for 0067cfb0 (0067cfb0-0067d59c); ghidra decompile on the same address succeeds. The export path and the proto path disagree.
python tools/bsp.py scan-bytes rejects a contiguous hex string and has no --start/--end; it needs space-separated bytes and only a --section filter.
python tools/bsp.py ghidra disasm --start refuses an address that is inside a truncated stored body, which is correct but means disasm-raw is the only way to page a large function.
